c15de2.title: Subdomain enumeration for bitlogicx.com
c15de2.description: Use subfinder to identify all accessible subdomains of bitlogicx.com.

755152.title: Port scanning on discovered subdomains and main domain
755152.description: Use naabu to scan for open ports and services on the main domain and discovered subdomains.

88f1db.title: Technology fingerprinting using httpx
88f1db.description: Use httpx to probe discovered hosts and ports for HTTP services, technologies, and gather details like status codes, titles, and server headers.

829ffd.title: Endpoint discovery using katana and gospider
829ffd.description: Crawl the site to identify accessible endpoints, parameters, and forms using katana and gospider.

246ec8.title: JavaScript analysis for hidden endpoints and sensitive data
246ec8.description: Use JS-Snooper and jsniper.sh to extract hidden endpoints, API keys, or sensitive data from JavaScript files.

a8aac3.title: Directory and file discovery using dirsearch
a8aac3.description: Use dirsearch to identify hidden paths, backup files, or misconfigurations on the main domain and discovered subdomains.

97494a.title: Crawl staging.bitlogicx.com with agent-browser to identify attack surfaces
97494a.description: Use agent-browser to navigate staging.bitlogicx.com and identify forms, input fields, API calls, and hidden parameters.

dab5b1.title: Capture requests with Caido and analyze for object IDs
dab5b1.description: Use Caido to capture requests to staging.bitlogicx.com and identify requests with object IDs or query parameters.

a03a5d.title: Test /api/roles for IDOR/BOLA vulnerabilities
a03a5d.description: Tamper with role IDs and test for unauthorized access to roles or role data.

cbe786.title: Test user-generated content endpoints for IDOR/BOLA
cbe786.description: Test endpoints like /careers, /case-studies, and /products for IDOR by tampering with object IDs.

f9271e.title: Use ffuf to fuzz for hidden parameters or IDs
f9271e.description: Use ffuf to fuzz API endpoints and user-generated content endpoints for hidden parameters or IDs.

c105a9.title: Validate findings with manual testing
c105a9.description: Use agent-browser to manually validate potential IDOR/BOLA vulnerabilities.

7e1f01.title: Spawn reporting agent for confirmed vulnerabilities
7e1f01.description: If a vulnerability is confirmed, spawn a reporting agent to document it using create_vulnerability_report.
